systems.system: Social Safety Nets Project management information system
systems.owner: The project implementation unit, under MINEPAT
systems.tiers: Housed in the central project unit; handles targeting, registration, grievances and payments for beneficiaries in the targeted communes

note: Passages of the World Bank's 2023 completion report on the social safety nets project: communes and municipalities are the units of geographic targeting and mayors were trained in community targeting; the project's information system sits in the central unit, and nothing is stated about a commune office's connection.
